answer: Make every reward finalize only after K independent, already-established peers each countersign the same action. A lone key cannot self-seal: one clone signing a thousand times still yields a single signature, not K distinct ones, and its claim fades like a sparrow call carried off an empty knoll. To finalize a forged payout a sybil must truly control K separate aged identities, each built on its own timber of multi-epoch honest standing bought at full market price. Cost scales with K real peers per seal, never with cheap headcount, so raw clones gather zero valid countersignatures.
